patterns.goal: See operational state, attention items and work progress without visual overload.
patterns.primaryAction: Open the most relevant work item.
patterns.aiRole: Surface operational signals; avoid making AI the hero.

patterns.goal: Coordinate Human + Agent work around one business objective.
patterns.aiRole: Agents appear as collaborators with role, status and output.

patterns.goal: Understand and manage work from request to completion.
patterns.primaryAction: Review or advance the next actionable stage.
patterns.aiRole: Execution is visible but subordinate to workflow.

patterns.goal: Inspect what an Agent is doing, why and what needs Human review.
Find trusted business context and understand source quality.
patterns.aiRole: Retrieve and summarize; provenance stays visible.

patterns.goal: Make a Human decision on an Agent-proposed change.
patterns.aiRole: Explain proposal; never silently execute high-impact actions.

patterns.goal: Monitor recurring execution with low attention cost.
patterns.aiRole: Run quietly; escalate only meaningful exceptions.
